summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. All 34 rows reconcile 1:1 with the deposited y1819_design.tsv (sample name, RAW file, site, cultivar, date, leaf number) and all 34 PRIDE RAW files; controlled terms resolve; validator clean.

reviewer_context.context: fresh adversarial reviewer subagent without producer transcript; producer report treated as untrusted

spec_compliance.evidence: 34 rows x 31 columns, uniform row width, no CR/whitespace padding; templates ms-proteomics + plants (plants requires disease and developmental stage: present, reserved words allowed); sdrf-tools structure OK; factor value columns have matching characteristics columns; unique source names and data files.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in local ontology cache: ncbitaxon:4113 solanum tuberosum; bto:0000713 / po:0025034 leaf; ms:1002877 q exactive hf-x; ms:1001251 trypsin; ms:1002038 label free sample; pride:0000627 data-dependent acquisition; pride:0000608 dithiothreitol (dtt); pride:0000599 iodoacetamide (iaa); unimod:4 carbamidomethyl; unimod:35 oxidation. No obsolete or mismatched labels.

source_evidence.evidence: Organism/organism part/instrument match PRIDE record (NEWT:4113, BTO:0000713, MS:1002877). DTT 10 mM and iodoacetamide 55 mM, in-gel trypsin digest stated in PRIDE sample protocol. CAM C fixed, Ox M variable, 10 ppm / 0.02 Da from deposited X!Tandem input parameters. Site (Borgeby/Umea), cultivar Desiree, dates and leaf numbering checked programmatically per row against y1819_design.tsv: 0 mismatches. DDA inferred from MGF + MS-GF+/X!Tandem search workflow (paper not accessible).

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE file list has 34 RAW files; SDRF comment[data file] set equals it exactly (34/34, no duplicates, no non-raw files). PEAK/SEARCH/OTHER files correctly excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed groups from design table: Bo 2018-07-23 (6), Um 2018-07-26 (6), Bo 2018-08-15 (6), Um 2018-08-17 (6), Bo 2019-07-18 (4, des7-10), Um 2019-07-25 (6) = 34. Biological replicate equals SampleInternalleafnumbering; technical replicate 1 and fraction 1 consistent with one run per sample (single short-stacked gel piece).

omission_safety.evidence: Disease and developmental stage set to 'not available' rather than guessed; cell type 'not applicable' for tissue. Regional qualifiers (southern/northern Sweden) are geographic facts about the named sites, PRIDE country Sweden. No unsupported specific values found.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t plants --use_ols_cache_only: 'Everything seems to be fine' exit 0; auto-template run exit 0; sdrf-tools check --offline CLEAN exit 0; sdrf-tools score 100/100; sdrf-tools structure OK; sdrf-tools reconcile: every value agrees with deposit record.
